name: starry-steward
description: Read-only access to your Starry Steward short-term rental account: properties, reservations, booking statistics and year-over-year comparison. Guest names, contact details and messages are never shared.

interface.longDescription:
Starry Steward is a property management app for short-term rental hosts in Korea. Connect your Starry Steward account to ask ChatGPT about your properties: upcoming check-ins and check-outs, how many nights are booked, revenue and channel mix for a period, and how this period compares with the same period last year.

The connection is read-only. ChatGPT cannot change prices, block dates or message guests. Reservations are shared as dates, number of nights, property, channel, guest count and amounts only. Guest names, contact details and messages are never shared.

Only the owner of a Starry Steward account can connect it, and the connection can be removed at any time.
defaultPrompt: Which of my properties have check-ins this week?
How many nights did I sell last month, and through which channels?
Compare my revenue this month with the same month last year.

positive.prompt: Which properties are in my Starry Steward account?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the two demo properties (Demo Stay 1 and Demo Stay 2) with their names.

positive.prompt: Show my reservations for the next 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: List upcoming demo reservations with dates, nights, property, channel and guest count. No guest names or contact details are shown.

positive.prompt: How many nights were booked last month and from which channels?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the number of booked nights and the channel mix for last month from the demo account.

positive.prompt: Compare this month's revenue with the same month last year.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare reservation count and revenue for this month and the same month last year. If last year has no data, say so instead of inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: Which property has the most check-ins in the next two weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Count upcoming check-ins per demo property and name the property with the most.

negative.prompt: Send a message to my next guest with the Wi-Fi password.
Raise the price of Demo Stay 1 to 300,000 won for this weekend.

negative.description: Guest contact details are not shared
negative.prompt: What is the phone number of the guest checking in tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the host's own reservation data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only properties, reservations, booking statistics and year-over-year comparison.

ko-KR.subtitle: 숙소 예약을 한눈에
ko-KR.description: 스테리 스튜어드는 한국의 단기 숙박 호스트를 위한 숙소 관리 앱입니다. 계정을 연결하면 ChatGPT에서 숙소별 입실·퇴실, 판매한 숙박 일수, 기간별 매출과 채널 비중, 작년 같은 기간과의 비교를 물어볼 수 있습니다. 연결은 읽기 전용이라 요금을 바꾸거나 날짜를 막거나 손님에게 메시지를 보낼 수 없고, 손님 이름·연락처·메시지는 공유되지 않습니다.
